name: SFC Environmental Technologies
summary: SFC Environmental Technologies, incorporated in 2005, provides technology, equipment and commissioning for wastewater treatment (its C-Tech sequencing batch reactor platform, with 728 installations), wastewater recycling and solid waste processing, including two municipal waste plants in Goa; most of its revenue comes from government-linked projects. Revenue from operations grew from ₹657.5 cr in FY24 to ₹803.6 cr in FY26 (about 10.6% a year), while profit rose only 5.4% in FY26 to ₹160.2 cr and operating cash flow was negative at -₹25.8 cr as borrowings more than doubled to ₹195.6 cr. About 78% of the ₹667.5 cr issue is an offer for sale, and none of the ₹150 cr fresh money goes to new capacity; promoter holding falls to 41.18%. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 20.2x, well below the RHP peers Thermax, Ion Exchange and Praj Industries.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹657.5 cr (FY24) to ₹803.6 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 10.6%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹657.5 cr, ₹697.9 cr, ₹803.6 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.24 at March 2026 (borrowings ₹195.6 cr vs net worth ₹804.2 cr).

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose 41% (₹139.2 cr to ₹195.6 cr) while revenue rose 22% over FY24–FY26; they more than doubled in FY26 alone.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹534.3 cr, ₹648.7 cr, ₹804.2 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was negative at -₹25.8 cr in FY26, against a ₹160.2 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 5.4% in FY26, to ₹160.2 cr, while revenue grew about 15%.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin fell from 21.93% (FY24) to 19.94% (FY26), a drop of about 2 percentage points.

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on equity was 21.55% in FY26.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 22.21% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: EBITDA margin of 29.34% in FY26 vs a peer median of 7.21% (Thermax 9.60%, Ion Exchange 7.21%, Praj 4.79%).

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 20.2x vs a peer median of 52.0x (Ion Exchange 31.3x, Thermax 52.0x, Praj 220.8x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 3.4x (₹3,233 cr market cap vs ₹954 cr post-issue net worth) vs a peer median of 4.1x.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue market cap to sales of about 4.0x (₹3,233 cr vs ₹803.6 cr) vs an implied peer median of about 1.7x (from peer P/E, profit and revenue).

checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: None of the ₹150 cr fresh issue funds capex or expansion; it goes to working capital, debt prepayment and general purposes.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: ₹42.2 cr, or 28.2% of the fresh issue, goes to prepaying borrowings of the company and its subsidiary.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: General corporate purposes take ₹32.9 cr, or 21.9% of the fresh issue.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Material civil litigation involving subsidiary SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH totals ₹66.7 cr, about 8.3% of net worth.

checks.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: Top 10 customers gave 64.44% of FY26 revenue (79.20% in Q1 FY27), mostly government-linked.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: Top 10 suppliers made up 55.66% of FY26 purchases, and reliance on a few suppliers is called out as a risk; single-supplier shares are not published.
